incidents.summary: Costain was identified as a subscriber to an illegal construction-industry blacklist and was subsequently among contractors facing High Court proceedings brought by Unite in 2017.

sources.title: Costain Group
sources.quote: Costain was revealed as a subscriber to the United Kingdom's Consulting Association, exposed in 2009 for operating an illegal construction industry blacklist.

sources.title: Costain Group
sources.quote: it was also one of the eight businesses that were involved in the launch in 2013 of the Construction Workers Compensation Scheme

sources.title: Costain Group
sources.quote: In December 2017, trade union Unite announced it had issued High Court proceedings against twelve major contractors, including Costain.

incidents.summary: Costain was suspended from the UK Government's Prompt Payment Code for failing to pay suppliers on time in April 2019 and reinstated in July 2019.

sources.title: Costain Group
sources.quote: In April 2019, Costain was suspended from the UK Government's Prompt Payment Code, for failing to pay suppliers on time.

positives: Costain achieved BSI verification to the expanded PAS 2080:2023 carbon-management standard following an assessment of its processes and projects.
The HS2 Skanska Costain Strabag joint venture used a zero-trim piling solution reported to have saved 840 tonnes of CO2 equivalent.
Costain tested a carbon-tracking platform on road, water and integrated transport projects to improve construction-emissions reporting.
